BuildDefaults.description: Shared build configuration defaults under `[build]` in `resumake.toml`.

font_path.description: Custom font directory relative to project root (or absolute).

out_dir.description: Default PDF output directory relative to project root (or absolute).

schema.description: Custom content JSON Schema path relative to project root (or absolute).

template.description: Default template name, local template directory, or `.typ` file path.

DocConfig.description: Configuration for a single named document entry under `[docs.<name>]`.

content.description: Path to the résumé content file (`.yaml`, `.yml`, or `.json`).

output.description: Optional explicit output PDF filename or path for this document.

publish.description:
Whether bare `rsmk build` (and release builds) include this document
(default `false` so new variants remain drafts until opted in).

schema.description: Optional per-document content JSON Schema override.

OrphanPolicy.description: Handling policy for wrapped bullets ending in a short trailing line.

oneOf.description: Emit a diagnostic warning without failing the run.
Fail layout checks when a wrapped bullet ends with a short tail.

TelemetryPolicy.description: Configurable layout telemetry thresholds enforced by `check` and `build`.

max_bullet_lines.description: Maximum rendered lines permitted per guarded bullet or row (default `1`).

orphan_lines.description:
Policy for wrapped bullets with short trailing lines (`ignore`, `warn`,
`error`; default `ignore`).

strict_fonts.description:
Require requested `theme.font_family` fonts to exist locally without
fallback (default `true`).
